narrative.overview: The system is built around two opposing physical forces: mass (the deep void, the monumental headline, the refractive glass monolith) and voltage (a single electric blue, used as a verdict rather than a decoration). Nothing else is allowed on screen. Every component, every spacing decision, every easing curve serves one of those two forces or it gets cut. The result is meant to feel less like a website and more like architecture arriving in the room — gravitationally heavy, slightly impossible, calm. The palette is all black, with one signal blue. The typography is all Geist, ranging from 12px monospace labels to 160px display weight. There are no decorative gradients, no secondary accent hues, no warm fills.
keyCharacteristics: One accent. One voice. One verdict per viewport.
Negative space is the primary material. Three-quarters of any frame is void.
Type carries the brand louder than color does.
Glass and refraction stand in for shadow and elevation.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Voltage covers ≤10% of any visible viewport area at rest. Its rarity is the entire mechanism by which it carries weight. Two voltage moments per viewport, never three.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: #FFFFFF is forbidden as a text or surface color. Use Bone (#F5F5F7).

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black-Except-The-Void Rule
rules.body: #000000 is reserved for the Void surface itself. Every other black surface is Obsidian (#050507).

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Background gradients between brand colors are prohibited. Voltage-to-Plasma text gradients are banned by reflex.

rules.name: The -0.04em Rule
rules.body: Every Display tier uses letterSpacing -0.04em. The tracking is the brand.

rules.name: The All-Caps-Mono Rule
rules.body: Every label, eyebrow, nav link, and CTA is Geist Mono 12px uppercase tracking 0.16em. The metadata voice of the system.

rules.name: The One-Display-Per-Section Rule
rules.body: A section may have one Display-tier element. A second monumental headline in the same scroll-frame breaks gravitational pacing.

rules.name: The Editorial Line-Length Rule
rules.body: Body copy never exceeds max-w-md (28rem) or max-w-prose. Density separates manifesto voice from blog voice.

rules.name: The No-Shadow-Without-Voltage Rule
rules.body: Dark shadows are forbidden. Depth comes from tonal layering and glass. Every legal shadow contains the voltage RGB (59,142,255).

rules.name: The Two-Glows-Per-Viewport Rule
rules.body: At most two voltage glows may be visible at once. Three or more collapse into particle field and break the spell.

rules.name: The No-Button-Frame Rule
rules.body: Enclosed rounded-rectangle buttons with background fills are forbidden in body content. CTAs are typography-only command lines.

rules.name: The No-Icon-Tile Rule
rules.body: Icons never sit inside a rounded colored tile. They are naked against the surface, monochrome at rest, voltage on interaction.

dos: Do treat Voltage (#3B8EFF) as a verdict, not a decoration. One use per viewport, two maximum.
Do anchor every section in negative space. Three-quarters of any frame should be void.
Do use Micro (Geist Mono 12px, uppercase, tracking 0.16em) for every label, eyebrow, nav link, and CTA.
Do keep display-tier headlines at letterSpacing -0.04em and lineHeight 0.95.
Do use the cinematic easing curves (cinematic, smooth-out, silk, inertial) and the fixed duration scale.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: GSAP timelines short-circuit, Lenis disables, the 3D scene returns null.
Do keep all elevated surfaces in the three-tier glass system (glass-subtle / default / prominent).
Do use Bone (#F5F5F7) for primary text and Obsidian (#050507) for surfaces. Never pure black, never pure white.
donts: Don't introduce purple-to-blue gradients, hero metrics, or rounded-icon-tiles-above-headings.
Don't build identical card grids repeated endlessly without internal variation.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent.
Don't apply background-clip: text to a gradient. Gradient text is forbidden.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Glass appears only on the three approved tiers.
Don't use the <Environment preset=...> helper in any 3D scene. Only custom point lights are allowed.
Don't wrap copy in containers wider than max-w-md for body text or max-w-3xl for section headers.
Don't use #FFFFFF or #000000 for anything except the absolute Void surface.
Don't add bouncy or elastic easings. Motion in this system is gravitational.
Don't use em dashes in copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't write 'we craft experiences', 'we are passionate', 'the future is now', or any voiceover-tier marketing copy.
Don't ship a section that could still work with a different studio's logo on it.
